errors.where: earphone cable below and right of the player
errors.what: The cable from the top plug splits into more strands than the two earbuds need. One extra strand loops back behind the player and has no clear end, so it is unclear where the Y-split is.

cards.fix: single earphone cable running from the jack on top of the player to one clear Y-split, then two short cables to the two earbuds, no extra loose strands

errors.where: mount between the truss clamp and the lamp body
errors.what: The clamp's stem goes straight down into a collar on top of the lamp body instead of the top of the yoke. The yoke arch only passes behind the stem, so the lamp is fixed rigidly to the stem and the yoke's side pivots do nothing.

cards.fix: truss clamp stem connects to the center top of the U-shaped yoke; the lamp body hangs between the yoke arms on side pivot knobs, with a clear gap between the lamp body and the stem
